decisive_items: a well-defined, homogeneous, oval mass arising from the posterior gastric wall
response.rationale: Fat-tissue attenuation on CT is pathognomonic for lipoma and is the most specific feature, whereas GIST and leiomyoma do not contain fat. Ulceration is non-specific and does not exclude lipoma.

rejected.why: Lacks the fat-tissue attenuation that is the defining imaging finding; ulceration alone is not discriminative.
Same lack of fat attenuation; typical leiomyoma would not show fat-tissue attenuation on CT.
